heading: 🌙 The short version
terms: 🕯️ Confess is a place to say what you can't say anywhere else. Be honest, be kind, and protect other people's anonymity the way you'd want yours protected.
🔞 You must be 18 or older to use Confess.
🎭 Your alias hides who you are from other people. It does not make you untraceable, and it is never a licence to hurt someone.
📜 These guidelines cover everything on Confess: confessions, responses, reactions, polls, unsent letters, stories, aliases and avatars. Creating an account means you agree to them.

heading: 💬 What belongs here
terms: 🤫 Secrets, regrets, crushes, guilt, small wins, and things you've never told anyone.
😤 Swearing, anger and raw feelings are fine when you're venting. They're not fine when aimed at a person to hurt them.
🫂 Asking for advice, or choosing "Just listen" when you only want to be heard.
✉️ Unsent letters to people in your life, as long as they leave out names and details that would identify them.

heading: 🛡️ Keep everyone anonymous
terms: 📵 Never post anyone's full name, phone number, address, email, workplace, school or class, social media handle, photos, or anything else that lets people work out who they are.
🕵️ Don't try to unmask the person behind an alias, and don't ask others to help you do it.
📸 Don't share someone's private messages, screenshots or secrets in a way that identifies them.
🚷 Never share intimate images, or sexual details about a real, identifiable person, without their consent. This means a permanent ban.
🎭 Don't pretend to be someone else: a real person, a public figure, another member, or the Confess team.

heading: 🚫 Hate and harassment
terms: ☮️ No attacking or demeaning people for their religion, caste, race, ethnicity, nationality, region, language, gender, sexual orientation, disability or illness.
🎯 No bullying, no pile-ons, and no confessions written to humiliate a specific person.
🔁 No following someone around the app after they've blocked you or asked you to stop.

heading: ⚠️ Violence and threats
terms: 🔪 No threats to hurt anyone, including ones framed as a joke or as "hypothetical".
💣 No praising, promoting or recruiting for terrorism, violent extremism or mass violence.
🔥 No content meant to start riots, communal violence, or attacks on any group.
🩸 No graphic descriptions of gore or cruelty to people or animals posted to shock.

heading: 🧒 Child safety: zero tolerance
terms: ⛔ Any sexual content involving someone under 18 is banned. That includes text, images, drawings, "fiction" and "jokes".
🚸 No grooming. That means no sexual talk with minors, no asking a minor for photos, and no trying to move a minor to another app or meet them.
🚓 When we find it, we remove it, ban the account permanently, keep the evidence, and report it to Indian law enforcement through the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal and as the law requires.
📞 If a child is in danger, call 112 or Childline 1098, or report it at cybercrime.gov.in. You can read our full child safety standards at confess.mohammadramiz.in/child-safety.

heading: 🔒 Sexual content
terms: 🙈 Confess is not for porn or explicit sexual content. Talking about relationships, desire or your love life is fine if you keep it non-graphic.
🚫 No sexual harassment, unwanted sexual comments, sextortion or blackmail.
💸 No offering, selling or asking for sex or sexual services.

heading: 🫂 Self-harm and hard days
terms: 🌧️ You can talk about pain, depression or thoughts of ending your life. We will never remove you for being honest that you're struggling.
🚫 Never encourage anyone to hurt themselves. Don't share methods, and don't glorify suicide, self-harm or eating disorders.
🚩 If someone seems to be in danger, report their post as "Threats or self-harm risk" so we can look at it quickly.
📞 If you're struggling right now, call Tele-MANAS on 14416. It's free and open 24×7. In an emergency, call 112.

heading: 💊 Illegal and dangerous things
terms: 🚫 No buying, selling or arranging drugs, weapons, or anything else that's illegal, and no instructions for making them.
🎰 No betting or gambling promotions, scams, fraud, fake schemes or money laundering.
🦠 No malware, phishing, or links meant to trick people.

heading: 📢 Honesty and spam
terms: 📣 No ads, referral codes, follow-for-follow, or promoting other apps, channels or groups.
🧪 No deliberately false information meant to mislead people. That includes fake news, rumours about real people, and edited or AI-made images or videos made to deceive (deepfakes).
📊 Polls should be real questions. Don't use them to rate, rank or shame real people.
👥 One person, one account. Don't use extra accounts to boost reactions, mass-report someone, or get around a ban.
©️ Only post things you have the right to share.

heading: 🪪 Aliases, avatars and stories
terms: 🏷️ Aliases and avatars follow the same rules: nothing hateful, sexual or impersonating, and nothing that reveals who a real person is.
⏳ Stories disappear after 24 hours, but the rules still apply while they're up, and you can report them.

heading: 🚩 Reporting and blocking
terms: 🏳️ Tap the flag on any confession, response, story or profile to report it. Reports are anonymous: nobody is told who reported them.
🙈 A confession you report is hidden for you straight away. If enough people report it, it's hidden for everyone until a moderator reviews it.

⛔ Block anyone from their profile or from the flag menu on their confession. You'll stop seeing their confessions, responses and stories, and they won't see yours. They aren't told. You can unblock people in Settings → Blocked people.
⚖️ Reporting people just because you disagree with them is itself against these guidelines.

heading: ⚖️ How we enforce these rules
terms: 🤖 Every confession, response, alias and avatar is checked by automated moderation before it goes up. If something is held back, nothing is posted and we tell you why.
👀 Moderators review reports. Depending on how serious it is, we remove the content, warn you, suspend your account for a while, or ban it permanently.
🚫 Child sexual content, credible threats, and sharing intimate images without consent mean a permanent ban the first time.
🏛️ We follow valid legal requests from Indian authorities. When the law requires it, we may share the account details we hold, such as your sign-in email, IP addresses and timestamps.
🔁 If you think we got a decision wrong, write to the Grievance Officer below and we'll look at it again.

heading: 📮 Grievances and contact
terms: 👤 Grievance Officer and child safety contact: Mohammad Ramiz Anas, ramizanas6@gmail.com.

⏱️ We acknowledge complaints within 24 hours and resolve them within the time limits set by India's IT Rules, 2021 (as amended in 2026). Complaints about nudity, sexual content, impersonation or morphed images of you are handled first.
🏛️ If you're not satisfied with our decision, you can appeal to the Grievance Appellate Committee at gac.gov.in.
🗑️ You can delete your account and everything you've posted at any time from Settings.

heading: 📜 The legal part
terms: 🇮🇳 Under Rule 3(1)(b) of India's IT (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, you must not post or share anything that:
1️⃣ belongs to someone else and you have no right to share;

2️⃣ is obscene, pornographic or paedophilic; invades someone's privacy, including bodily privacy; insults or harasses on the basis of gender; is racially or ethnically objectionable; relates to or encourages money laundering or gambling; or promotes enmity between groups on grounds of religion or caste with intent to incite violence;
3️⃣ is harmful to children;
4️⃣ infringes any patent, trademark, copyright or other proprietary right;
5️⃣ deceives or misleads about where a message came from, or knowingly and intentionally spreads misinformation or information that is patently false, untrue or misleading;
6️⃣ impersonates another person;

7️⃣ threatens the unity, integrity, defence, security or sovereignty of India, friendly relations with other countries, or public order; incites any cognisable offence; prevents the investigation of any offence; or insults another nation;
8️⃣ contains software viruses or other code meant to interrupt, destroy or limit any computer resource;
9️⃣ is an online game that hasn't been verified as permissible;
🔟 is an advertisement or surrogate advertisement for a game, platform or intermediary that isn't permissible;
1️⃣1️⃣ or violates any law in force.
⚠️ Breaking these rules can lead to removal of the content, suspension or termination of your account, and action under the IT Act, 2000, the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 and other laws.
🔔 We'll remind you of these rules at least every three months, and tell you in the app when they change. Indian law governs these guidelines.
